title: CD3 / BGS (Breast Cancer Now Generations Study) — derived variables (schemify pilot) — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

missing_numeric.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_numeric.description: The derivation logic could not determine a value and no more specific sentinel applies -- agent-decided, since the source schema used bare null with no distinguishing code. Open for steward confirmation at review.

missing_string.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_string.description: String-typed equivalent of missing_numeric, for the (rare) string-valued fields in this table.

not_applicable.title: Not applicable
not_applicable.description: The derivation logic determined the field is structurally not applicable to this participant (e.g. too young at baseline, no live birth, currently pregnant) -- adopted verbatim from the source schema, which already used 9999 for this meaning consistently across ~12 properties (distinct from bare null, which meant genuinely missing information).
